privacyGdprSec2Title: 2. Scope and Categories of Personal Data
privacyGdprSec2Body: We process the following categories of personal data for the service:
privacyGdprSec2Item1: Account and profile identifiers (username, user ID, display name).
privacyGdprSec2Item2: Authentication data and tokens (including Roblox OAuth tokens).
privacyGdprSec2Item3: Contact data (email address) when required for account and service notices.
privacyGdprSec2Item4: Usage and service interaction logs (timestamps, IP/device metadata, session security events).
privacyGdprSec2Item5: Optional communication preferences and records for non-essential communications.
privacyGdprSec2Item6: Support and administrative records where needed for dispute handling, abuse prevention, and compliance.
privacyGdprSec3Title: 3. Purposes of Processing and GDPR Legal Bases
privacyGdprSec3Body: We process personal data only where a valid legal basis under Article 6 GDPR applies. The table below maps each processing purpose to its legal basis.
privacyGdprSec3Row1Data: Account identifiers, OAuth tokens, session metadata
privacyGdprSec3Row2Data: Profile data, service actions, technical logs
privacyGdprSec3Row3Purpose: Security monitoring, fraud prevention, abuse detection
privacyGdprSec3Row3Data: IP/device metadata, access logs, event records
privacyGdprSec3Row4Purpose: Mandatory service emails (account, security, legal notices)
privacyGdprSec3Row4Data: Email address, account status, notice records
privacyGdprSec3Row5Data: Email address, preference choices, engagement metrics
privacyGdprSec3Row6Purpose: Compliance with legal obligations and law enforcement requests
privacyGdprSec3Row6Data: Relevant account, usage, and legal records
privacyGdprSec3Footnote: Where processing is based on legitimate interests, we apply a balancing test to ensure our interests do not override your fundamental rights and freedoms.
privacyGdprSec4Title: 4. Roblox OAuth and International Data Transfers
privacyGdprSec4Body1: The service uses Roblox OAuth for authentication. As a result, authentication data may be transferred to or accessed from countries outside the European Economic Area (EEA), including countries that may not have an adequacy decision from the European Commission.
privacyGdprSec4Body2: When personal data is transferred outside the EEA, we apply appropriate safeguards, including:
privacyGdprSec4Item1: European Commission Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs), where applicable.
privacyGdprSec4Item2: Transfer impact assessments and supplementary technical measures as needed.
privacyGdprSec4Item3: Data minimization and strict access controls for transferred data.
privacyGdprSec5Body1: We separate service-critical emails from optional communications:
privacyGdprSec5Item1: Strictly necessary emails (account access, security alerts, essential policy updates, and service notices) are sent under Article 6(1)(b) GDPR because they are required to deliver the service contract.
privacyGdprSec5Item2: Optional emails (newsletters, feature announcements, non-essential updates) are sent only with your consent under Article 6(1)(a) GDPR.
privacyGdprSec5Body2: You can opt out of optional emails at any time by using the unsubscribe link in the email or by contacting us at info@hsrgames.hu. Opting out does not affect strictly necessary service emails.
privacyGdprSec6Body1: The service is not intended for children under 16 years of age in the EEA unless parental or guardian consent has been validly provided where permitted by local law. In Member States that set a lower digital consent age (not below 13), that national age threshold applies.
privacyGdprSec6Body2: If we learn that personal data has been collected from a child without the required consent, we will delete that data without undue delay.
privacyGdprSec7Body: We implement technical and organizational measures appropriate to risk, including:
privacyGdprSec7Item1: Encryption in transit (TLS) and encryption at rest for sensitive data stores.
privacyGdprSec7Item2: Role-based access controls and least-privilege administrative access.
privacyGdprSec7Item3: Secure handling, rotation, and storage of authentication tokens and secrets.
privacyGdprSec7Item4: Audit logging, anomaly monitoring, and incident response procedures.
privacyGdprSec7Item5: Regular updates, patching, and security hardening of infrastructure.
privacyGdprSec7Item6: Backups, recovery controls, and data integrity safeguards.
privacyGdprSec8Body: We retain personal data only for as long as necessary for the relevant purpose and legal basis:
privacyGdprSec8Item1: Account and profile data: retained for the duration of the account and up to 30 days after deletion requests, unless longer retention is legally required.
privacyGdprSec8Item2: Authentication and security logs: retained for up to 12 months to detect and investigate abuse, incidents, and unauthorized access.
privacyGdprSec8Item3: Support and dispute records: retained for up to 24 months after case closure to manage legal claims and service integrity.
privacyGdprSec8Item4: Consent records for optional emails: retained while consent is active and for up to 3 years after withdrawal to demonstrate compliance.
privacyGdprSec8Item5: Legal compliance records: retained as required by applicable law.
privacyGdprSec8Body2: When retention is no longer necessary, data is deleted or irreversibly anonymized.
privacyGdprSec9Body: You have the following rights under GDPR, subject to legal conditions:
privacyGdprSec9Item3: Right to erasure ("right to be forgotten").
privacyGdprSec9Item7: Right to withdraw consent at any time (where processing is consent-based).
privacyGdprSec9Item8: Right to lodge a complaint with your local supervisory authority.
privacyGdprSec9Body2: To exercise your rights, contact info@hsrgames.hu with the subject line "GDPR Request". We may request identity verification before completing your request.
privacyGdprSec10Body: We will update this Privacy Policy when required by legal, technical, or operational changes. Material changes will be communicated through the service or by email where appropriate.

termsGdprSec14Body1: All donations and support payments made through the HSR platform are voluntary contributions intended to support server costs, development, and community events. Once a payment is processed and confirmed, it is considered final and non-refundable.
termsGdprSec14Body2: By completing a donation, you acknowledge and agree that: (a) the payment is a voluntary contribution and not a purchase of goods or services; (b) no refunds, chargebacks, or reversals will be issued except as required by applicable law; (c) if you believe an error has occurred, you must contact us within 48 hours of the transaction through our official support channels.
termsGdprSec14Body3: We reserve the right to refuse or reverse donations that violate these terms, including fraudulent transactions. In such cases, the associated account may be suspended.
termsGdprSec14Body4: As part of this support model, we may show Google AdSense advertisements to users who have not yet reached the Supporter threshold. These ads are used solely to fund platform operation and development costs.
privacyGdprSec11Body1: When you make a donation through the HSR platform, payments are processed exclusively by Stripe, a PCI DSS-compliant payment processor. HSR does not collect, store, or have access to your full payment card details (card number, CVV, expiry date) at any point during or after the transaction.
privacyGdprSec11Body2: The information we do retain related to your donation is limited to: the donation amount, the transaction timestamp, a reference identifier provided by Stripe, and the fact that a successful payment occurred. We use this data solely to: award Supporter status, send confirmation emails, and maintain accurate financial records as required by law.
privacyGdprSec11Body3: Your payment data is never sold, shared, or used for marketing purposes. For questions about how Stripe handles your data, please refer to Stripe's Privacy Policy at stripe.com/privacy.

privS12Body2: We retain the following donation-related data: the amount, the timestamp, the Stripe reference identifier, and the fact of a successful payment. This is used solely to award Supporter status, send confirmation emails, and maintain financial records as required by law.

privS13Body: We update this Privacy Policy when required by legal, technical, or operational changes. For material changes, we notify you via the Service and/or email, and update the "Last updated" date. We recommend reviewing this page periodically.

trmS1Intro: These Terms of Service ("Terms") govern your use of HSR – Hungarian State Railways Simulation (the "Service"). The Service provider is:
trmS2Body: By creating an account, signing in through Roblox OAuth, or otherwise using the Service, you agree to these Terms and our Privacy Policy. If you do not agree, you must not use the Service.
trmS3Body1: You must be at least 16 years old to use the Service in the EEA, unless your Member State permits a lower digital age of consent (not below 13) and all legal requirements are met.
trmS3Body2: Where parental or guardian consent is required by law, you may use the Service only if such consent has been validly obtained.
trmS4Body1: The primary authentication method is Roblox OAuth 2.0. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your credentials and for all activities performed through your account. You must provide accurate information and keep it up to date.
trmS4Body2: We may suspend or terminate accounts that violate these Terms or applicable law.
trmS5Body1: Access to protected Service features (e.g. duty system, exams, schedule, wiki, admin panels) requires linking your Discord account registered on the HSR Discord server.
trmS5Body2: The roles you hold on the HSR Discord server determine which features and permissions you have access to within the platform. Roles are managed exclusively on the Discord server by authorized staff.
trmS6Body1: The platform uses a priority-based permission system (0–100 scale). Higher-priority roles grant broader access. Permissions are mapped to 20 defined flags covering duty, scheduling, supervision, admin functions, and more.
trmS6Body2: In-platform permissions update automatically based on Discord roles (every 60 seconds). Some permissions can be individually overridden by an administrator.
trmS7Item1: Use the Service for unlawful, fraudulent, or abusive activities
trmS7Item2: Attempt unauthorized access to other accounts, systems, or data
trmS7Item3: Interfere with Service availability, security, or integrity
trmS7Item4: Use automated methods to extract or scrape data without permission
trmS7Item5: Impersonate any person or misrepresent your affiliation
trmS7Item6: Deliberately circumvent or manipulate the duty system, exams, training, or schedules
trmS7Item7: Distribute malicious code, spam, or harmful content within the Service
trmS8Intro: Users holding certain roles (e.g. Train Driver, Dispatcher, and related roles) are required to meet a weekly duty minimum.
trmS8Item1: Users who fail to meet the weekly minimum automatically receive a WeeklyDutyStrike.
trmS8Item2: Accumulated strikes may result in loss of privileges or account suspension.
trmS8Item3: Strikes can be contested through the DutyAppeal system.
trmS8Item4: Advance exemptions can be requested (e.g. for holiday or illness) via an administrator.
trmS8Item5: Exemptions (WeeklyDutyExemption) cover specific date ranges and require admin approval.
trmS9Intro: Users with Trainee and related statuses are required to attend scheduled training sessions.
trmS9Item2: Repeated unexcused absences may result in more serious consequences (e.g. suspension or demotion).
trmS9Item3: The training instructor informs participants of expectations and consequences.
trmS10Intro: Exams are conducted under rules set by the administrator. By participating in an exam, you accept the following:
trmS10Item1: Browser tab switching, window switching, and application focus loss are prohibited and automatically recorded (ExamViolation).
trmS10Item2: An administrator may force-stop the exam at any time.
trmS10Item3: Multiple violations may result in exam invalidation (VIOLATION status) and sanctions.
trmS10Item4: Exam results (score, status, answers) are permanently stored and may be used for eligibility decisions.
trmS10Item5: Exam images and uploaded content are stored on Cloudflare R2.
trmS11Body1: The Wiki section can only be edited by users with the MANAGE_WIKI administrator permission. Content published on the platform (articles, images, descriptions) is the intellectual property of HSR Games.
trmS11Body2: Do not upload, publish, or share third-party copyrighted content, personal data, or infringing material.
trmS12Body1: The support ticket system must be used for genuine issues and questions. Abusive, deliberately misleading, or spam submissions may result in account suspension.
trmS12Body2: You agree to receive strictly necessary service notices (e.g. security, account, and legal notifications). Optional communications (e.g. newsletters) are sent only with your consent.
trmS13Intro: The iOS and Android mobile application communicates with the web platform via OAuth 2.0.
trmS13Item1: Mobile access tokens are valid for 7 days; refresh tokens for 90 days.
trmS13Item2: Tokens are stored in the device's secure storage (SecureStore).
trmS13Item3: On a 401 error, the mobile app automatically attempts to refresh the token.
trmS13Item4: The iOS Live Activity feature displays active duty data in real time on the notification surface.
trmS13Item5: App versions (.apk, .ipa) are distributed through Cloudflare R2 storage.
trmS14Intro: We may suspend or terminate your access if:
trmS14Item2: you create a legal or security risk, or
trmS14Item3: you engage in misuse of the Service.
trmS14Body: Where reasonably possible, we will provide notice and an opportunity to remedy the issue. You may stop using the Service at any time and request account deletion under the Privacy Policy.
trmS15Body: Personal data processing is governed by our Privacy Policy. You will find there the purposes and legal bases for processing, your GDPR rights, retention periods, international data transfers, and security safeguards.
trmS16Body: Unless otherwise stated, the Service – including software, branding, and content – is owned by HSR Games or its licensors and protected by applicable intellectual property laws. These Terms grant you a limited, non-exclusive, revocable right to use the Service for its intended purpose.
trmS17Body: To the maximum extent permitted by law, the Service is provided "as is" and "as available" without express or implied warranties. We do not exclude liability where exclusion is prohibited by law, including liability for fraud, wilful misconduct, or gross negligence.
trmS18Body: We may update these Terms for legal, security, or operational reasons. For material changes, we will provide reasonable advance notice via the Service and/or email. Continued use of the Service after the effective date constitutes acceptance of the updated Terms.
trmS19Body1: These Terms are governed by the laws of Hungary, without prejudice to mandatory consumer protections applicable in your country of residence.
trmS19Body2Pre: For disputes, you may first contact us at
trmS19Body2Post: to attempt an informal resolution. You also retain the right to contact a competent court or supervisory authority under applicable law.
trmS20Body1: All donations and support payments made through the platform are voluntary contributions intended to fund server costs, development, and community events. Once a payment is processed and confirmed, it is final and non-refundable.
trmS20Body2: By completing a donation, you acknowledge and agree that:
trmS20Item1: (a) the payment is a voluntary contribution, not a purchase of goods or services;
trmS20Item2: (b) no refunds, chargebacks, or reversals will be issued except as required by applicable law;
trmS20Item3: (c) if you believe an error has occurred, you must contact us within 48 hours of the transaction via support.
trmS20Body3: Google AdSense ads may be displayed to users who have not reached Supporter status. These ads are used solely to fund platform operation and development costs.

botWelcomeDesc:
Hi **{username}**! I can help with common questions and some account actions (like cancelling one of your train bookings) right here.

Just describe your issue. If you'd rather talk to a staff member, use the button below at any time.
botHumanOfferDesc: It sounds like you'd like to speak with a staff member. Want me to bring one in?
botEscalationDefaultNote: A member of our support team will take over from here. Thanks for your patience!
botEscalationSensitiveNote: This is something our staff should handle directly. Bringing someone in now.
botEscalationModelDownNote: Let me get a staff member to help you with this.
botCancelConfirmDesc: Are you sure you want to cancel your booking?
botCancelPickerDesc: You have more than one upcoming booking. Pick the one you'd like to cancel.
botNoBookings: I couldn't find any upcoming train bookings on your account that can be cancelled. If you think this is wrong, use {humanButton} and a staff member will check.
botCancelSuccessDesc: Your booking for train **{train}** (departure {departure}) has been cancelled.
botCancelTooCloseDescWithTime: This booking departs at **{departure}** within the hour, so I can't cancel it automatically. I'll bring in a staff member to help.
botCancelTooCloseDescNoTime: This booking departs within the hour, so I can't cancel it automatically. I'll bring in a staff member to help.
botCancelDeniedDesc: That booking can't be cancelled (it may not be yours, or it's already resolved). Let me get a staff member to check.
botLeaveNeedDatesDesc:
I can book your leave here, but I need the exact period first.

Send me the **start and end date** — for example `10 August – 20 August`, `2026-08-10 to 2026-08-20`, or *"from next Monday until the Monday after"*. Hungarian works too.
botLeaveNeedReasonDesc:
Got it — **{start} → {end}** ({days}).

What's the reason for the leave? A short line is enough (holiday, exams, illness, work…).
botLeaveConfirmDesc: Check everything below. If anything is wrong, press **Edit** and send the corrected details in one message.
botLeaveConfirmFooter: You can still take {remaining} day(s) of leave this month after this one.
botLeaveEditPrompt: No problem — send the corrected leave in one message (dates and reason together), and I'll read it again.
botLeaveCancelled: Cancelled — nothing was booked. Tell me the right dates whenever you're ready.
botLeaveGrantedDesc: Your leave is registered and the weekly duty requirement is adjusted for it. {emailedNote}
botLeaveGrantedEmailedNote: A confirmation email is on its way.
botLeaveRejectPastTitle: That period is in the past
botLeaveRejectPastDesc: Leave can only be booked for today or later. Send me the dates you actually need off.
botLeaveRejectTooLongDesc: You asked for **{requested} days**, but leave can be at most **{max} days**. Shorten the period, or use {humanButton} if you need something longer.
botLeaveRejectOverlapDesc: You already have leave booked from **{from}** to **{to}**, which overlaps this request. Pick dates outside that period, or ask a staff member to change the existing one.
botLeaveRejectMonthlyCapRemainingSome: You can still take **{remaining} day(s)** that month — send me a shorter period.
botLeaveRejectMonthlyCapRemainingNone: You have no leave left for that month. Use {humanButton} if the situation is exceptional.
botLeaveRejectNoAccountDesc: Your Discord account isn't linked to an HSR account, so I can't book leave against it. Log in at https://hsrgames.hu and link Discord, then come back — or use {humanButton}.
botLeaveRejectGoneDesc: I can't find this leave request any more. Tell me the dates again.
botLeaveRejectNoLongerOpen: This request is no longer open. Send me the dates again if you still need leave.
botAppealPolicyDesc:
You can appeal here, and how many times depends on what you're appealing:

• **Termination** — up to **3** appeals in total
• **Warnings** — up to **5** appeals in total
• **Missed duty** — **no limit**, appeal every one of them

Tell me which one you'd like to appeal and I'll take your case to the team.
botAppealNeedReasonDesc: Write your reasoning in **one message** — what happened, and why you think the decision should be changed. I'll pass it to the team exactly as you write it, and they decide.
botAppealNeedReasonFooterRemaining: Appeals of this type left after this one: {remaining}.
botAppealTooShort: That's a bit short for the team to work with. Please write a few sentences: what happened, when, and why the decision should be reconsidered.
botAppealExhaustedDesc:
You've already used all **{limit}** {type} appeals, so I can't submit another one.

If you believe this is a mistake, use {humanButton} and a staff member will look at it.
botAppealSubmittedDesc: Your {type} appeal is with the team now. You'll get the decision right here in this ticket.
botAppealAcceptedDesc: Your {type} appeal was **accepted** by {staff}. They'll sort out the details with you here.
botAppealRejectedDesc: Your {type} appeal was **rejected** by {staff}. If you have new information, you can raise it here.
botResolvedDesc: I'll close this ticket now. If anything else comes up, just open a new one — we're here.
botInactivityDesc:
I haven't heard back in a while. If you don't reply, I'll close this ticket in about **{hours}**.

Just send a message if you still need help.
botTicketOpenedDesc:
Welcome, **{username}**!

Please describe your issue and our support team will get back to you shortly.
